title: Functions, arguments and return values
summary: Write small functions with explicit inputs and outputs so data transformations are testable and composable.

blocks.text: Write small functions with explicit inputs and outputs so data transformations are testable and composable.

items: Prefer a returned value over mutating hidden global state.
Use keyword-only parameters for options that are easy to confuse.
Default arguments are evaluated once; avoid mutable defaults such as [].
Type hints document contracts but do not enforce runtime types by themselves.
